description: This file implements native methods and functions related to managing video surfaces and native windows on Android, including surface change handling, surface clearing, and EGL context management.

classes.name: VideoSurfaceHolder
classes.description: Class managing the lifecycle and state of the video surface and native window, including acquiring, releasing, and clearing the video window.

methods.name: IsVideoSurfaceAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a video surface is available and not held by any decoder.

methods.name: AcquireVideoSurface
methods.description: Acquires the current video surface if available.

methods.name: GetVideoWindowSize
methods.description: Retrieves the width and height of the current native video window.

methods.name: ClearVideoWindow
methods.description: Clears or resets the native video window, optionally forcing a reset based on conditions.
